title: A Preliminary Framework for Intersectionality in ML Pipelines
reasoning: The paper focuses on applying the sociological framework of intersectionality to machine learning pipelines to address bias. While it includes 'Ethical Considerations and Transparency' as one of its five analytical guidelines, this is used to evaluate the methodology of research case studies regarding reflexivity and harm prevention, rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as a primary subject.
